evidence: The new commits do not change selector discovery. It still checks Select kind after choosing the first id/category match.
The new Copilot safety gate does not change config capability validation; discovery still accepts the current value as restore without requiring off.
The providers/mod.rs change only adds disabled_prompt_block_reason; a non-Select id/category match can still hide a later valid Select option.
The new provider changes do not require Copilot's configured off restore value as part of capability validation.
At head c41aaafd, capability discovery still stops at the first id/category match before validating Select kind.

At current head, YoloState::effective ignores session_id and returns only the global default, while client prompt guards use this value for provider permission safety. There is no later fixing commit.
